chain: The heartbeat renews the lease with UPDATE generation_tasks ... WHERE id=?; a worker transaction holding that row FOR UPDATE blocks it.
Pre-fix AgentRunStore.complete froze the VERIFIED outcome (process-wide synchronized, toRealPath per segment) before its lease-checked READY transition.
A freeze longer than the remaining 3 s lease made the transition fail with "Lease is no longer active"; SQL rolled back after the outcome was atomically on disk.
Recovery failed the task; DraftConvergence then found SNAPSHOT_ALREADY_FROZEN (CONFLICT): SQL FAILED, store VERIFIED (audit V2).

A renew that began before expiry and waited on the row until the rollback is not re-evaluated under READ COMMITTED, so it revived the lease and failIfLeased recorded FAILED/INVALID_STAGE_RESULT; otherwise recovery recorded FAILED/INTERRUPTED.
Pre-fix draft froze the source inside the row lock and re-checked the lease afterwards: lease lost, no version, FAILED/INTERRUPTED.
